title: Roman to integer
summary: Return the value of the Roman numeral `roman`.
hints: Work out MCMXCIV by hand. At which symbols did you subtract instead of add, and what told you to?
A symbol is subtracted exactly when the symbol after it is larger. Otherwise it is added.
Map each symbol to its value. For each position, compare its value with the next symbol's value: subtract it if the next one is larger, add it otherwise. The last symbol is always added.
takeaway: Turning a rule stated in words into "compare each item with its neighbour" is a very common move. A small lookup table (a map or a switch) keeps the symbol values out of the logic.
